title: Blind Review Packet
description: The complete input handed to a blind artifact reviewer. The packet is the reviewer's entire view of the candidate; anything not named here is withheld by design.

issue.description: The authoritative GitHub Issue holding the acceptance contract.

pull_request.description: The pull request carrying the candidate commit and the verdict labels.

candidate_commit.description: Exact full SHA of the candidate. Every verdict binds to this SHA.

acceptance_contract.description: Repository-relative path to the approved acceptance contract.

artifact_url.description: Immutable URL of a playable or viewable candidate build, when one exists.

evidence.description: Repository-relative paths to required candidate evidence (captures, reports, manifests).

command.description: Deterministic command that launches the candidate.

clean_state_command.description: Command that resets the candidate to a clean state between playtest rounds.
